开启时只选择静态掩体可见的瞄点；关闭后按穿透静态掩体后的预计伤害选择大于0的瞄点: When enabled, only aim points visible through static cover are selected. When disabled, select points with positive estimated damage after static-cover penetration. Unknown or zero damage does not trigger a shot.
每个已核验骨骼只分析其命中体的一个内部瞄点；射线先碰到同一目标的其他部位时，满足: Analyze one interior hitbox aim point per verified bone. A first hit on another part of the same target can fire if it meets that hitbox's inset; other players are controlled by the player obstruction switch.
开启时射线必须先命中所选目标；关闭时可先命中包含对象中的其他人物，仍需满足实际命: When enabled, the shot must first hit the selected target. When disabled, another included player may be hit first if that hitbox meets the inset requirement. Excluded players still block the shot.
没有可造成伤害的目标骨点: No target bone has positive estimated damage
目标读到的视角与自身方向夹角在15°内估计威胁，正对为1、15°及以外为0；缺失: Threat estimates the target's view direction toward you: 1 when aligned, falling to 0 at 15 degrees. Missing direction contributes no threat score. Weighted with normalized visible-bone damage, it does not confirm that the target has selected you.
只分析已包含对象的当前已核验骨点，静态掩体可见才计分。开火前确认同一目标、命中部: Only current verified bones of included targets are scored when statically visible. Before firing, the current ray must confirm the same target, hitbox and inset. An excluded player in front blocks firing.

启用后仅在本机游戏处于前台时自动瞄准和射击；关闭独立RCS和Triggerbot: Automatically aim and fire only while the local game is foreground. Independent RCS and Triggerbot are turned off, and Aimbot is suspended. Switching away immediately stops output.
敌人读到的视角与自身方向夹角在15°内估计威胁，正对为1、15°及以外为0；缺失: Threat is estimated from the enemy's view direction toward you: 1 when directly aligned, decreasing to 0 at 15 degrees. Missing direction contributes no threat score. This is weighted with normalized visible-bone damage; it does not confirm the enemy has selected you.
只枚举当前已核验骨点，静态掩体可见才计分；先按威胁与未封顶预计伤害选人，再优先该: Only current verified bones are candidates, and only visible static-cover paths are scored. Threat and uncapped damage rank targets; the highest-damage bone is preferred for that enemy. A current-frame ray confirms the target, hitbox and inset before firing. A teammate in front blocks firing.
